justification: The most specific possible correspondence is only that both are carved stone objects with roughly worked surfaces, but there is no clearly shared depicted motif: A is a three-dimensional human-like figure or head-and-torso, while B is a flat slab covered with low-relief signs, animals or abstract forms in horizontal zones. The biggest difference is the whole mode of image-making—single volumetric figure versus organized incised/relief panel—so their arrangement and style do not correspond.
